results.title: Singapore faces AI-linked ransomware at 1.5 times global
results.description: Identity systems and staff safety are under growing strain as six in 10 Singapore organisations hit by ransomware said attackers used AI.

results.title: Meta releases open-weight Muse Spark model for coding, agentic tasks
results.description: Meta Platforms on Thursday released an open-weight version of its Muse Spark artificial intelligence model for coding and AI agents, expanding developers’ ability to download and adapt the technology. Open-weight models make trained parameters available for developers to modify, unlike proprietary models that remain under their creators’ control. They can offer businesses a lower-cost alternative to closed systems. Meta said Muse Spark has 816 billion total parameters, with 42 billion active at a time, and can handle a context window of up to 1 million tokens
